facts.text: The hotel was designed by British architect Richard Seifert and unveiled in 1973.
facts.excerpt: Designed by renowned British architect Richard Seifert and unveiled in 1973

facts.text: The building's circular form and expansive windows were designed to showcase views across Hyde Park, Knightsbridge and London's landmarks.
facts.excerpt: Its iconic circular form and expansive windows were designed to showcase the city offering views across Hyde Park, Knightsbridge and London's celebrated landmarks.

facts.text: The hotel has direct access to Knightsbridge Tube Station and the Piccadilly Line.
facts.excerpt: with direct access to Knightsbridge Tube Station and the Piccadilly Line

facts.text: Harvey Nichols and Harrods are both within a few minutes' walk of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Shop at upscale boutiques or the famed Harvey Nichols department store for innovative European designers or explore in the halls of Harrods with its panoply of luxury goods; both within a few minutes walking distance

facts.text: The signature suites are positioned to capture sweeping views across the city, from Hyde Park and Westminster to Lowndes Square, Sloane Square and Knightsbridge.
facts.excerpt: Each suite is positioned to capture sweeping, uninterrupted views across the city. From Hyde Park and the landmarks of Westminster to Lowndes Square, Sloane Square and Knightsbridge, London unfolds in every direction.

facts.text: Marble bathrooms have bathrobes and slippers, a heated vanity mirror, and walk-in showers with glass doors and bathtubs.
facts.excerpt: Marble bathrooms feature...See More plush bathrobes and slippers, a heated vanity mirror, and walk-in showers with glass doors and bathtubs.

facts.text: With The Park Tower Butler service, a personal butler contacts guests before arrival to plan their itinerary and handle special requests.
facts.excerpt: This luxury service begins before you arrive when your personal butler contacts you to begin planning your itinerary and navigating any special requests.

facts.text: Suites booked with butler service include packing and unpacking service.
facts.excerpt: Packing and unpacking service

facts.text: The Lowndes Penthouse Suite is a two-bedroom suite bordered by districts such as Belgravia.
facts.excerpt: Bordered by London’s most desirable and wealthiest districts, such as the famous Belgravia, your two-bedroom penthouse suite

facts.text: The Knightsbridge Lounge, where afternoon tea is served, has an 18-foot teardrop glass chandelier and a hand-painted canopy of magnolia blossom on draped silk.
facts.excerpt: the tea parlour is surrounded by a hand painted canopy of magnolia blossom on draped silk and features a spectacular 18-foot teardrop glass chandelier

facts.text: The Hyde Bar offers over 130 international premium whiskies.
facts.excerpt: The Hyde Bar offers premium drinks, fine foods, and over 130 international premium whiskies.

facts.text: The Trianon, reserved for hotel guests' breakfast, has floor-to-ceiling windows looking onto the outdoor terrace.
facts.excerpt: Reserved exclusively for our hotel guest’s breakfast, The Trianon is one of the most refined rooms in Knightsbridge. With spectacular floor-to-ceiling windows offering beautiful views of our outdoor terrace

facts.text: The concierge team is led by a Clefs d'Or head concierge.
facts.excerpt: Led by our Clefs d'Or head concierge

facts.text: A bespoke chauffeur service, with a footman if required, can arrange tours such as Richmond Park, Hampton Court or Windsor Castle.
facts.excerpt: offering an exceptional range of vehicles available complete with a chauffeur and a footman if required

facts.text: The fitness centre is open 24 hours a day, and private training, Pilates and yoga sessions can be arranged for an additional charge.
facts.excerpt: We are pleased to arrange private training sessions, private Pilates instruction with a certified Pilates teacher and private yoga sessions with a certified yoga master for an additional charge.

facts.text: Jogging maps of nearby Hyde Park are provided for guests who want to exercise outside.
facts.excerpt: Detailed jogging maps of nearby Hyde Park are also provided for guests who wish to exercise outside.

facts.text: The underground car park beneath the hotel is operated by a third party, Care Park, not by the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Please note that the car park is operated by a Third Party (Care Park) and not managed by the hotel

facts.text: Pets are not allowed; only service animals are permitted.
facts.excerpt: Pets are not allowed. Only service animals are allowed.

facts.text: Afternoon tea must be booked 24 hours in advance.
facts.excerpt: Bookings for Afternoon Tea need to be made 24 hours in advance.

facts.text: The Victoria and Albert Museum and the Saatchi Gallery are within walking distance of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Discover a range of fascinating exhibitions at the Victoria & Albert Museum or explore contemporary art at the Saatchi Gallery on King's Road; both within walking distance of our hotel in Knightsbridge.

facts.text: The hotel describes its butler service as a contemporary interpretation of white-gloved service.
facts.excerpt: who reaches beyond the white-gloved service of yesterday to a more contemporary interpretation
